intro: Apps Google named as optimised for the Pixel Fold and other large screens. Open the Google Play listing to install; many more apps support large screens and foldables.

apps.name: Google Keep
apps.note: Switches to a two-pane layout when you unfold the Pixel Fold, with a toggle to expand the notes list.

apps.name: Google Weather
apps.note: Shows only today when folded; unfolded it adapts to a two-pane layout with more weather detail.

apps.name: Deezer
apps.note: Two-pane player: artwork, lyrics and actions on one side, controls on the other.

apps.name: LINE
apps.note: Two-pane chat layout on the unfolded screen.

apps.name: SideChef
apps.note: A layout that keeps everything for a recipe in one view on big screens.
